council.Architect: Boundaries, ownership, contracts, invariants, migration paths
council.Originalist: Challenges the default framing and the familiar project pattern
council.Unoriginalist: Reuses established patterns, dependencies, and test seams; reads docs and history before inventing
council.Clean-slate Radical: First principles, best end state over smallest migration; names the compatibility breaks and irreversible choices
council.Product Visionary: Starts from the user's workflow — behavior, discoverability, ergonomics
council.Ruthless Minimalist: Smallest coherent change that fully satisfies the task
council.Genius Inventor: A non-obvious but implementable mechanism that materially improves the result
council.Detail Detective: Edge cases, state bugs, integration gaps, weak verification
council.Doomsayer: Failure modes, hidden costs, unsafe rollouts
council.Battle-scarred Operator: Deployment, observability, recovery, resource limits, day-two ownership
council.Performance Wizard: Bottlenecks in speed, memory, and throughput
council.Security Paranoid: Auth, untrusted input, injection, secrets, privilege boundaries
